title: The shared foundation
caption: Six Episodes carry both tracks; you have seen the first three today.

ai-attention-span.title: Why AI has a weird attention span you must learn to manage
ai-attention-span.body: What the model sees decides what it does.

onboard-ai-every-time.title: Treat AI like a brilliant freelancer with amnesia
onboard-ai-every-time.body: Brief it every session, as you would a new hire.

ai-gives-you-more-work.title: Will AI reduce your work? It adds work: managing it.
ai-gives-you-more-work.body: Delegating to AI is a job of its own: plan, check, decide.

from-shared-understanding-to-shared-cont.title: From shared understanding to shared context
from-shared-understanding-to-shared-cont.body: Requirements first: settle what done means before the work starts.

what-lies-below-the-waterline-of-sustain.title: What lies below the waterline of sustainable AI skills
what-lies-below-the-waterline-of-sustain.body: Skills: how a task is done, kept apart from what the AI knows.

what-agentic-workflows-require.title: What agentic workflows require of people and organisations
what-agentic-workflows-require.body: The principles behind agentic workflows, for people and teams.

talking-points.header: What we did, and what comes next
talking-points.description: The three badged cards are what we did today. The other three are where both tracks go next, whatever tool you use; each is an Episode you can watch. Context engineering runs through almost all of them, so it is a tag, not its own card.
